title: Kyle Mosler
content:
Kyle Mosler

Head of Growth & Marketing

Hi, I’m Kyle! I was born and raised in Florida and moved to the Pacific Northwest in 2016. I have a background in leadership and growth strategy, with experience spanning SaaS account management, coaching, social media management, and regional management leading expansion efforts across multiple states. I also graduated with my BFA in Dance Performance from the University of Florida. Throughout my career, I’ve been drawn to roles where I can build strong foundations, connect with people, and drive meaningful, sustainable growth. Joining Life Skills Advocate in 2025 was a natural fit. I’m passionate about helping organizations that make a real difference scale their impact while staying true to their mission. As Head of Growth & Marketing, I work closely with Chris and Karrissa to expand our reach, refine strategic goals, optimize the client journey, and launch new initiatives that help us better serve our community. My goal at LSA is to help create a stronger, more accessible support network for individuals and families, ensuring that the resources we offer reach those who need them most. Outside of work, I love dancing, traveling, creating content, and spending time with my husband, Juan, and our cat, Oliver.
author: ChrisHanson
